explanation: ব্যাখ্যাঃ Despite শব্দটির অর্থ- সত্ত্বেও। প্রদত্ত অপশনগুলোর অর্থ in spite- পরিবর্তে, under নিচে, avoiding –এড়িয়ে; যা বাক্যের সাথে সম্পর্কযুক্ত নয়।

question: 15. What is the Compound structure of the sentence “Though he is poor, he is honest”? [NESCO-EEE/ME-24]

He is poor but he is honest

question: 16. Complex form of “I know his birth place” is- [NESCO-EEE/ME-24]
options: I know where was his birth place.
I know where he is born.
I know his birth place where way.
I know where he had born.
answer: (b) I know where he is born.
explanation: ব্যাখ্যাঃ যে Sentence-এ একটি principal clause এবং এক বা একাধিক sub-ordinate clause থাকে তাকে complex sentence বলে। Sub-ordinate clause টি sub-ordinate conjunction দ্বারা শুরু হয়। যেমনঃ though, although, till, until, which, what, when, who, since, as, that ইত্যাদি। Example: we know that he is honest, we know where he was born.

question: 23. I don't feel like ____ [BSTI-CE/Physics/EEE-24]

question: 24. “If it rains, the school will be closed” What is the contra-positive of this sentence? [CPGCBL-EEE/ME/CE-23]
options: If the school is closed then it is not raining
If the school is closed then it is raining
If the school is not closed then it is not raining
If the school is closed then it is not raining
answer: (c) If the school is not closed then it is not raining
explanation: ব্যাখ্যাঃ প্রদত্ত sentence- টির contrapositive form হল- If the school is not closed then it is not raining. বাক্যটির অর্থ যদি স্কুল বন্ধ না রাখা হয় তাহলে এর অর্থ এখন বৃষ্টি হচ্ছে না।

explanation: ব্যাখ্যাঃ Everybody থাকলে Nobody বসে এবং verb এর Antonym হয়। সুতরাং, Nobody hates flower.

question: 58. Where ................ coming from? [BADC-ME-16]
explanation: ব্যাখ্যাঃ Wh-question থাকলে, Interrogative করার নিয়মঃ- Wh+Auxiliary+ subject + main verb. So, Where are you coming from?

question: 59. ................... football? [BADC-ME-16]
explanation: ব্যাখ্যাঃ Have you ever played football? আপনি কখনও ফুটবল খেলেছেন?

question: 60. Which type of sentence is it – “Do or die” [BEPZA-ME-16]
explanation: ব্যাখ্যাঃ or, and, but দ্বারা যুক্ত Sentence হল compound sentence.

question: 61. Which of the following sentences is correct: [BCIC-ME-16]
options: A drowning man catches to a straw.
A drowning man catches with a straw.
A drowning man catches at a straw.
A drowning man catches about a straw.
answer: (c) A drowning man catches at a straw.
explanation: ব্যাখ্যাঃ ইংরেজি প্রবাদ বাক্য; A drowning man catches at a straw. যার অর্থ: যতক্ষণ শ্বাস ততক্ষণ আশ।

question: 62. Which of the following sentences is correct: [GTCL-ME-16]
options: Why did you have done this?
explanation: ব্যাখ্যাঃ Wh-question auxiliary verb + subject + main verb + complement? So, why + have + you + done + this?

question: 63. Which of the following sentences is correct: [GTCL-ME-16]
options: I forbade him not to go.
explanation: ব্যাখ্যাঃ forbade অর্থ নিষিদ্ধ: আমি তাকে যেতে নিষেধ করেছি। I forbade him to go.

question: 64. He is true, ----------. [ERL-ME-17]
explanation: ব্যাখ্যাঃ He is true, isn’t he? Tag Question করার সময় বাক্যের শেষে auxiliary verb + not + subject অনুযায়ী pronoun + প্রশ্নবোধক চিহ্ন বসে।

question: 65. Which of the following is a correct simple sentence? [46th BCS]
options: All that glitters is not gold.
I shaw an old man walking past me
answer: (d) I shaw an old man walking past me
explanation: ব্যাখ্যাঃ Simple sentence- এ একটি subject এবং একটি Finite verb থাকে। প্রদত্ত (গ) অপশন-এ একটি subject 'I' এবং একটি finite verb ‘saw’ থাকায় তা একটি simple sentence।

question: 66. Which is the correct complex form of the sentence? ‘A corrupt man can not win the respect of others.’ [46th BCS]
options: A man who is corrupt cannot respect others.
A man does not respect others who are corrupt.
A man who is corrupt cannot win the respect of others.
A man who can win the respect of others cannot be corrupt.
answer: (c) A man who is corrupt cannot win the respect of others.
explanation: ব্যাখ্যাঃ Complex sentence-এ দুটি clause থাকে এবং clause দ্বয় relative pronoun (that, since, when, if) ইত্যাদি দ্বারা যুক্ত থাকে।

question: 67. The submarine dipped to avoid ...... by the enemy plane. [46th BCS]
explanation: ব্যাখ্যাঃ Sentence টি passive form-এ থাকায় being + v3 (seen) হবে সঠিক উত্তর।

question: 68. In fear of ..... he escaped else where. [46th BCS]
explanation: ব্যাখ্যাঃ অন্যের দ্বারা arrest হওয়া অর্থে sentence টি passive form এ রয়েছে যেখানে, ‘being arrested’ হবে সঠিক।

question: 69. I didn’t follow who passed by me. It ..... Shajib. [46th BCS]
explanation: ব্যাখ্যাঃ অনিশ্চয়তা প্রকাশ করতে may/might ব্যবহত হয়। যেহেতু বাক্যেও শুরুতে বলা হয়েছে ‘I didn’t follow’ তাই অনিশ্চয়তা জ্ঞাপন অর্থে might be হবে সঠিক উত্তর।

question: 70. Identify the correct sentences: [46th BCS]
options: He has said to me that I will go but you will stay there in Dhaka.
He has told me that he will go but I will stay there in Dhaka.
He has told me that I would go but you would stay there in Dhaka.
He has told me that he would go but I would stay here in Dhaka
answer: (b) He has told me that he will go but I will stay there in Dhaka.
explanation: ব্যাখ্যাঃ Narration এর rules অনুযায়ী Indirect speech-এ reporting speech এর subject অনুযায়ী subject বসে এবং reporting speech এর tense অনুযায়ী reported speech এর tense বসে। অর্থাৎ, reporting speech এ present tense থাকলে reported speech এর tense অপরিবর্তিত থাকে। এ নিয়ম অনুযায়ী অপশন ‘খ’ সঠিক।

question: 71. Identify the correct sentences: [46th BCS]
options: The room was darkened by switching off all the lights.
The room was darkened switching off all the lights.
The room was darkened to switch off all the lights.
Switching off all the lights the room was darkened.
answer: (a) The room was darkened by switching off all the lights.
explanation: ব্যাখ্যাঃ বাক্যটি passive form এ থাকায় ‘by switching off’ phrase টি সঠিক।

question: 72. Identify the correct sentences: [46th BCS]
options: Had you been there on time, you could have had the information.
If you had been there on time, you could have the information.
Had you been there on time, you could have had the information.
Had been youthere, you could have got the information.
answer: (a) Had you been there on time, you could have had the information.
explanation: ব্যাখ্যাঃ Third Condition এর নিয়ম অনুযায়ী প্রথম অংশে had + subject + v2 থাকলে পরের অংশে could/would/might + have + v3 হয়।

question: 73. Identify the correct sentences: [46th BCS]
options: There are trees on the both sides of the road.
There are trees on both the sides of the road.
There are trees on both side of the road.
There are trees on either sides of the road.
answer: (b) There are trees on both the sides of the road.
explanation: ব্যাখ্যাঃ প্রদত্ত option গুলোর মধ্যে (b) সঠিক। কারণ both the side হল সঠিক form।
